sub_graphs.title: EIP-7732: Execution Payload Commitment and Reveal Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of execution payload commitments from builder bid through reveal and inclusion, replacing the traditional single-step block production.

nodes.label: Builder Bid Submitted
nodes.description: A builder has submitted a SignedExecutionPayloadHeader containing a bid value and blockhash commitment

nodes.label: Proposer Selects Builder Bid
nodes.description: The beacon block proposer selects a builder's signed header commitment to include in the beacon block

nodes.label: Commitment Included in Beacon Block
nodes.description: The SignedExecutionPayloadHeader is included in the beacon block body, replacing the full execution payload

nodes.label: Deduct Builder Payment
nodes.description: The builder's beacon chain balance is debited by the bid value, creating a BuilderPendingPayment

nodes.label: Builder Payment Pending
nodes.description: BuilderPendingPayment exists in beacon state, awaiting payload reveal confirmation

nodes.label: Builder Reveals Execution Payload
nodes.description: Builder broadcasts SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope containing the full execution payload matching the committed blockhash

nodes.label: Execution Payload Revealed
nodes.description: The full execution payload envelope is available on the network for PTC attestation

nodes.label: PTC Attests to Payload Timeliness
nodes.description: Payload Timeliness Committee (512 validators) broadcasts PayloadAttestationMessages indicating payload_present and blob_data_available

nodes.label: Slot Full (Payload Included)
nodes.description: Both beacon block and execution payload are included on-chain for this slot

nodes.label: Slot Empty (Payload Withheld)
nodes.description: Beacon block included but committed execution payload was withheld by the builder

nodes.label: Next Proposer Validates Execution Payload
nodes.description: The next slot's proposer validates the execution state transition and commits to the beacon state root

nodes.label: Builder Payment in Withdrawal Queue
nodes.description: BuilderPendingPayment moved to BuilderPendingWithdrawal queue for execution layer credit

edges.label: Builder submits signed execution payload header via P2P
Selected commitment included in beacon block body
Builder reveals full payload matching commitment
PTC members verify payload presence and blob availability
Threshold met (>=256 of 512 PTC): payload confirmed timely
Threshold not met or payload absent: slot marked empty
Next proposer validates execution state transition
Payment moved to withdrawal queue for EL credit

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7732: Execution Payload Envelope Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the multi-stage validation of execution payload envelopes including signature, blockhash, state root, and withdrawal matching.

nodes.label: Execution Payload Envelope Received
nodes.description: A SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope has been received from the builder

nodes.label: Verify Builder Signature
nodes.description: Validate the BLS signature on the execution payload envelope against the builder's public key

nodes.label: Verify Blockhash Matches Commitment
nodes.description: Confirm the envelope's blockhash matches the blockhash in the previously committed header

nodes.label: Validate Execution State Transition
nodes.description: Execute the payload and verify the resulting state transition is valid

nodes.label: Verify Withdrawals Root Match
nodes.description: Confirm execution payload withdrawals match state.latest_withdrawals_root

nodes.label: Verify Beacon State Root
nodes.description: Confirm envelope's state_root matches the actual post-execution beacon state root

nodes.label: Envelope Fully Validated
nodes.description: All validation checks passed; execution payload is accepted

nodes.label: Envelope Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed; envelope is rejected

edges.label: Builder broadcasts signed envelope via P2P
Signature valid, proceed to blockhash check

external_entities.name: Builder via P2P Network
external_entities.description: Builder node broadcasting the signed execution payload envelope over the consensus P2P network

nodes.label: Fork Choice Node Payload Empty
nodes.description: A fork choice node where execution payload was withheld (status=EMPTY)

nodes.description: Process PayloadAttestationMessage from PTC member, updating ptc_vote tracking in the store

nodes.label: Determine Payload Status
nodes.description: Evaluate PTC votes against PAYLOAD_TIMELY_THRESHOLD (256) to determine if payload is present

nodes.label: Compute Chain Head
nodes.description: Run modified fork choice incorporating payload availability signals from attestation index field

nodes.label: Chain Head Selected
nodes.description: Fork choice has determined the current chain head considering payload status

>=256 PTC votes confirm payload present and blobs available

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7732: Trust Boundaries and Attack Surfaces
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries between proposers, builders, PTC members, and the network, including equivocation and collusion attack surfaces.

nodes.label: Builder Reveals Conflicting Payloads
nodes.description: Builder has broadcast multiple different execution payloads for the same slot commitment (no slashing penalty)

nodes.label: PTC Split View
nodes.description: PTC members have inconsistent views of payload availability due to equivocation or network delays

nodes.label: Detect Builder Equivocation
nodes.description: System detects conflicting payloads from same builder for same slot (no slashing applied by design)

nodes.label: Proposer-Builder Collusion Scenario
nodes.description: Colluding proposers controlling consecutive slots with >20% stake can reorg a builder's payload while keeping payment

nodes.label: Verify Unconditional Proposer Payment
nodes.description: System ensures proposer receives payment regardless of whether builder reveals payload (safety property)

nodes.label: Proposer Unconditionally Paid
nodes.description: Proposer has received builder's bid value even if payload was withheld

edges.label: Equivocation causes PTC members to see different payloads
Consecutive proposers with >20% stake attempt reorg

external_entities.name: Equivocating Builder
external_entities.description: A builder that broadcasts conflicting execution payloads for the same slot to create split views

external_entities.name: Colluding Proposer Set
external_entities.description: A set of proposers controlling consecutive slots with >20% total stake, attempting to reorg builder payloads

ambiguities.text: PTC attests to payload being revealed in a 'timely fashion' but exact timing thresholds are deferred to consensus-specs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume timeliness means the payload is available before PTC attestation deadline. The PAYLOAD_TIMELY_THRESHOLD of 256/512 votes serves as the quorum. Exact timing parameters must be verified in consensus-specs.

ambiguities.text: blob_data_available is a single boolean but the specification does not define behavior when some blobs are available and others are not.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob_data_available requires ALL blobs referenced in the commitment to be available. Partial availability is treated as unavailable.

ambiguities.text: The interaction between EPBS and Casper FFG finality regarding payload withhold attacks is claimed safe but supporting analysis is minimal.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the claim holds under honest majority assumption. Mark for deeper analysis in security audit phase.

ambiguities.text: If a beacon block is rejected and subsequent slot is skipped, the status of BuilderPendingPayment is unclear.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BuilderPendingPayment is only created if the beacon block is accepted into the chain. If rejected, no payment is created.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker controlling 35% of total stake requires approximately 205,000 years to gain majority control of the PTC.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If PTC can be controlled more cheaply (e.g., through validator redistribution or stake concentration), payload censorship and forced empty slots become feasible.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builder equivocation is tolerable without slashing because the cost (revealed payload may not be included) is sufficient deterrent.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If equivocation cost is negligible, builders can repeatedly cause split PTC views, degrading consensus quality and enabling MEV extraction attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network propagation is reliable enough that honest PTC members will see the payload before the attestation deadline.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Under network partitions or high latency, honest payloads may be marked as withheld, causing builders to lose payments for timely-revealed payloads.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builders will maintain sufficient beacon chain balance to cover bids, requiring periodic deposit transactions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders with insufficient balance cannot participate, potentially reducing competition and increasing centralization risk.
